# Georgetown Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for Georgetown. This service covers inspection and cleaning of accessible forced-air ductwork and related air-handler sections where cleaning is supported by observed conditions.

Email: contact@georgetownheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://georgetownheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: Georgetown, Guelph, Milton, Fergus, Elora, Acton, Rockwood. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
